abstract: Maintains structural stability verification, ballast telemetry enablement, and ballasting rate logs
system_message:
You are the Marine salvage engineering director (SALV), responsible for maintaining structural stability verification, ballast telemetry enablement, ballasting rate logs, and shearleg crane barge readiness data.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural stability verification, ballast telemetry enablement, and ballasting rate logs（STAB）
information_points.content:
SALV-STAB-UT7：For the Controlled Hull Girdling and Direct Pumping plan, active ballast monitoring enablement is true across the stricken vessel's ballast tanks, and the candidate emergency pumping manifold provides a continuous ballasting rate of 350 m3/h.
SALV-STAB-K1K：For the Dynamic Deflection and Deep Skimming Array, active ballast monitoring enablement is true across the stricken vessel's ballast tanks, and the continuous ballasting rate verified for the candidate emergency pumping manifold is 550 m3/h.
SALV-STAB-JAR：For the Perimeter Boom Containment and Subsea Inerting plan, active ballast monitoring enablement is true across the stricken vessel's ballast tanks, and the emergency pumping manifold achieves a continuous ballasting rate of 550 m3/h.

information_points.title: Shearleg crane barge readiness（CRANE）
information_points.content:
SALV-CRANE-ZH4：For Perimeter Boom Containment and Subsea Inerting, the designated emergency floating shearleg crane barge provides a certified shearleg crane lift capacity of 1200 t at 25 m outreach.
SALV-CRANE-ULU：For the Dynamic Deflection and Deep Skimming Array, the designated floating shearleg crane barge provides a certified shearleg crane lift capacity of 800 t at 25 m outreach.
SALV-CRANE-W8H：For Controlled Hull Girdling and Direct Pumping, the designated emergency floating shearleg crane barge has a certified shearleg crane lift capacity of 1600 t at 25 m outreach.
